mapper.select: select id, shop_id, user_id, consignee, phone, region, detail_address, is_default, created_at, updated_at from address where user_id = #{userId} and shop_id = #{shopId} order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into address (shop_id, user_id, consignee, phone, region, detail_address, is_default, created_at) values (#{shopId}, #{userId}, #{consignee}, #{phone}, #{region}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault}, now())
mapper.update: update address set consignee = #{consignee}, phone = #{phone}, region = #{region}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, is_default = #{isDefault}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.delete: delete from address where id = #{id} and shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.update: update address set is_default = 0 where user_id = #{userId} and shop_id = #{shopId}
update address set is_default = 1 where id = ( select t.id from (select id from address where user_id = #{userId} and shop_id = #{shopId} order by id desc limit 1) t )
